prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a beautifully art-directed Korean manufacturing business homepage, flat browser screenshot, 1024x1536. Fictional brand HANGYEOL, navigation 회사소개 / 제품소개 / 구축사례 / 기술지원 and 문의하기. Premium commercial theme with contemporary Korean sans typography, generous space and impeccable alignment. Pure WHITE backgrounds throughout outside photographs. One blue accent in buttons and small details. No colored section bands, dark footer, customer logos, invented success statistics, decorative badges, tiny English filler, dashboard cards or numbered process infographics. Realistic clean industrial photography. All UI feasible with ordinary Tailwind CSS, React, Lucide arrows; not a screenshot of code. Show a coherent homepage down to a compact white footer, not a comparison board. DESIGN A: ARCHITECTURAL FRAME. Hero is one beautiful huge sunlit automated factory photograph, almost full width, with subtly rounded 16px corners and ample white outer space. Oversized white headline anchored bottom left inside photo: "더 나은 생산의 시작". Small white outline button "솔루션 살펴보기". Header elegant and spacious. Below hero place a large black editorial statement on left and a compact paragraph on right. Then TWO large product photographs side by side, each with clean product title underneath, no cards or borders. After that one restrained latest-news row with dates and titles, followed by a large simple inquiry statement. This should look like a premium contemporary architecture studio meets Korean engineering brand. Bright, inviting, uncluttered; avoid dark factory imagery. Photo dominates upper half, bottom is airy.
